notes.title: Mine Arm Movement Fixed!
notes.content: Due to popular request the mining arm movement has been overhauled!

notes.title: Foreign Galaxy Update!
notes.content: Due to popular request, the movement of the mining arm has been overhauled, along with some minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Foreign Galaxies out now!
notes.content:
We welcome you to Foreign Galaxies, enjoy the adventure of trying to return home!

Any feedback is highly appreciated and valued so if you play the game do leave a comment, any ideas will be taken into serious consideration!

notes.title: Foreign Galaxies v1.0 out in a few days!
notes.content:
Wishlist now so you don't miss out on the upcomind launch of Foreign Galaxies!

Foreign Galaxies is under a review process so the final release date is expected within the next 2 weeks!

Come join the adventure and help us improve the game even further with your support and feedback!
